I have created a 3D mobile Subway Surfers-style endless runner game in [index.html](https://github.com/kamalmaity5k-web/first-project/blob/main/index.html)!

### 🎮 **Live Preview**
You can play the game right now here:
👉 **[Play Subway Runner 3D](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/97a72ac5-1dd8-4ed8-861e-6302c8ffb21d/29fa44efd30d03617a4fc8b4/)**

---

### 🕹️ **Mobile & Desktop Controls**
- **Swipe Left / Right** (or on-screen **◀ / ▶** or **A / D** / **Left / Right Arrows**): Switch lanes to dodge trains and barriers.
- **Swipe Up** (or on-screen **▲ Jump** or **W** / **Up Arrow**): Leap over low hurdles and onto train ramps.
- **Swipe Down** (or on-screen **▼ Roll** or **S** / **Down Arrow**): Slide and duck under overhead warning signs.
- **Double-Tap** (or on-screen **🛹 Board** or **Spacebar**): Activate a hoverboard that protects you from one crash!

---

### ✨ **Game Features**
- **3D Three-Lane Runner**: Built with Three.js featuring subway tracks, rails, tunnel walls, and signal lights.
- **Subway Obstacles**:
  - **Subway Trains**: Multiple colored train carriages, with rideable front ramps that let you run on the roof!
  - **Low Barriers**: Must jump over.
  - **High Barriers**: Must slide/roll under.
- **Collectibles & Power-Ups**:
  - 🪙 **Gold Coins**: With spinning animation and particle burst effects.
  - 🧲 **Coin Magnet**: Magnetizes nearby coins directly to you for 10s.
  - ⭐ **2X Score Boost**: Doubles all score gains for 10s.
  - 👟 **Super Sneakers**: Grants mega jump height to easily vault onto trains.
  - 🛹 **Hoverboard**: Emergency shield that saves you from a fatal crash.
- **Web Audio Sound Effects & BGM**: Synthesized jump whooshes, slide sounds, coin chimes, and upbeat background music (with a mute toggle).
- **High Score System**: Automatically saves your best run in your browser.
